p: Lewisham High Street is a big, bustling shopping street with a street market, lots of food stalls and the Lewisham Shopping Centre, and MERKUR at 97-99 is right in the thick of it. Lewisham station has both National Rail and DLR, so it's quick and easy to get to from central London or Docklands. It's an 18+ venue, strictly grown-ups.

Ladywell Fields, with its river walks, is a short stroll to the south. Blackheath is just up the hill, and beyond that Greenwich, with the park, the Royal Observatory and the Cutty Sark, makes a great day out.
